tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Bone by day, basalt by night. Page ground, about 70% of every screen. Warm, never pure white or pure black: warmth is what makes the violet read as premium instead of techy.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and forms. Ivory, not white.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Screenshot wells and code blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers only. Not for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Warm basalt black. Headings and body on paper and surface (15.7:1 light, 16.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and nav links (7.0:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Mono labels and metadata (5.2:1 light, 5.9:1 dark). The lightest text allowed.

tokens.name: jacaranda
tokens.usage: THE action colour, after Nairobi's jacaranda trees. Primary buttons, links, focus, the current-role rule. About 7% of a screen, and only on things you can press. As text 7.2:1 light, 8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: jacaranda-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state; text on jacaranda-mist (9.1:1 light, 9.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: jacaranda-mist
tokens.usage: Tint behind the selected contact route and 'New' badges.

tokens.name: on-jacaranda
tokens.usage: Text on a jacaranda fill (8.2:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: THE proof colour, after Kenya's red-gold earth. Fills only: the bar under a stat, list markers, the metric rule. About 3% of a screen. Never a button. Text on an ochre fill is ink (6.0:1).

tokens.name: ochre-text
tokens.usage: Ochre as text: result labels, metric eyebrows (5.2:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: ochre-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind result highlights. Text on it is ochre-text (4.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: acacia
tokens.usage: Means one thing: live / available. Availability dot, Live badge text (5.6:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: acacia-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Live badge.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pilot / in progress. Same hue as ochre-text: a pilot is proof on its way.

tokens.name: ink-band
tokens.usage: Ground of the flagship card and dark bands: basalt by day, jacaranda night in dark theme so it never melts into the page.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on ink-band (15:1).

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink-band.

tokens.name: on-band-jacaranda
tokens.usage: Links on ink-band (8.0:1).

tokens.name: on-band-ochre
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and list markers on ink-band (8.4:1).

tokens.name: band-well
tokens.usage: Screenshot well on ink-band.

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on ink-band and navy-fill.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Guest colour: SaTechs' own navy. Only for text and icons that hand off to SaTechs.

tokens.name: navy-fill
tokens.usage: The SaTechs band ground. Text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on navy-fill (12.8:1).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Body text on navy-fill (8.7:1).

tokens.name: on-navy-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrow on navy-fill: ochre, so the band still belongs to this brand.

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind 'Via SaTechs' badges. Text on it is navy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px, 2px offset.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: I build and test the systems that move money.
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. 44px on phones.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section titles on the home page. 34px on phones.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Proof numbers. Always paired with a caption that says what the number is about.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Card titles and case-study section heads.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Small headings inside cards and lists.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Senior engineer with a QA background.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display headline. Max 64 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Callbacks are matched to sessions automatically.
styles.usage: Default text. Max 72 characters a line.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, helper text under form fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and metadata, set in uppercase. ink-faint or ochre-text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: badge padding, label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; form label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap inside cards; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; large card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between hero blocks.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop (64px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs' inner elements, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and screenshot wells.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature bands: the flagship card, the SaTechs band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Availability pill and status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on paper. Most surfaces use a line border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered project cards. Pair with a 2px upward move.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Max line length for body copy.
